Flow.description: 2026-05-28: Adding additional fields to Quote creation Revenue Cloud quote creation flow with validation and field mapping

formulas.name: formulaContractErrorMessage
formulas.expression: CASE({!selectedQuoteType}, "Renewal", "Renewal quotes must be linked to the Contract being renewed. This ensures pricing and terms are calculated correctly.", "Amendment", "Amendment quotes must be linked to the Contract being modified. This ensures mid-term changes are applied correctly.", "Upsell", "Upsell quotes must be linked to the existing Contract. This ensures the additional products are added to the correct agreement.", "The selected quote type requires a Contract reference." )

formulas.name: formulaDealOriginErrorMessage
formulas.expression: IF({!formulaDealOriginChannelInvalid}, "The Deal Origin is Channel Originated, but no partner has been selected on the Opportunity. Please populate at least one of: Distributor, Reseller, or Referral Partner.", "" )

fields.name: Bill_To_Place_Error_Title
fields.fieldText: Missing Bill To Place

fields.name: Bill_To_Place_Error_Message
fields.fieldText:
A Bill To Place is required to create a quote. This determines where invoices will be sent.


To fix this:

  1. Return to the Opportunity
  2. Click Edit
  3. Select a Bill To Place from the dropdown
  4. Save the Opportunity
  5. Try creating the quote again

fields.name: Contract_Error_Title
fields.fieldText: Missing Contract Reference

fields.name: Contract_Error_Message
fields.fieldText:
{!formulaContractErrorMessage}


To fix this:

  1. Return to the Opportunity
  2. Click Edit
  3. In the "Renewed Contract" field, select the appropriate Contract
  4. Save the Opportunity
  5. Try creating the quote again

fields.name: Deal_Origin_Partner_Error_Title
fields.fieldText: Missing Partner for Deal Origin

fields.name: Deal_Origin_Partner_Error_Message
fields.fieldText:
{!formulaDealOriginErrorMessage}


To fix this:

  1. Return to the Opportunity
  2. Click Edit
  3. Populate the appropriate partner field based on Deal Origin:
    • If Deal Origin contains "Distributor", select a Distributor
    • If Deal Origin contains "Reseller", select a Reseller
  4. Save the Opportunity
  5. Try creating the quote again

fields.name: Legal_Entity_Error_Title
fields.fieldText: Missing Legal Entity

fields.name: Legal_Entity_Error_Message
fields.fieldText:
A Legal Entity is required to create a quote. The Legal Entity determines the billing company and tax jurisdiction.


To fix this:

  1. Return to the Opportunity
  2. Click Edit
  3. Select a Legal Entity from the dropdown
  4. Save the Opportunity
  5. Try creating the quote again

fields.name: Partner_Error_Title
fields.fieldText: Missing Partner Account

fields.name: Partner_Error_Message
fields.fieldText:
This appears to be a partner deal, but no Partner Account is assigned to the Opportunity.


To fix this:

  1. Return to the Opportunity
  2. Click Edit
  3. Select the appropriate Partner Account
  4. Save the Opportunity
  5. Try creating the quote again


If this is not a partner deal, please contact your Sales Operations team to update the Opportunity.

fields.name: PriceBook_Error_Title
fields.fieldText: Missing PriceBook

fields.name: PriceBook_Error_Message
fields.fieldText:
A PriceBook is needed to create a quote. The PriceBook determines which products and prices are available.


To fix this:

  1. Return to the Opportunity
  2. Click Edit
  3. Select a Price Book from the dropdown
  4. Save the Opportunity
  5. Try creating the quote again

fields.name: Ship_To_Place_Error_Title

fields.name: Ship_To_Place_Error_Message
fields.fieldText:
A Ship To Place is required to create a quote. This determines where products will be delivered.


To fix this:

  1. Return to the Opportunity
